messages.subject: mutate vs. summarize assignment semantics
parts:
mutate has the handy feature that it performs its column assignments sequentially rather than in parallel (the document says "iteratively", which isn't quite right...)

> mutate(data.frame(a=(1:5)^2),q=median(a),r=a-q)
   a q  r
1  1 9 -8
2  4 9 -5
3  9 9  0
4 16 9  7
5 25 9 16

But summarize does not:

> summarize(data.frame(a=(1:5)^2),q=median(a),r=mean(a)-q)
Error in mean(a) - q : non-numeric argument to binary operator

Goose, gander, sauce?

          -s
